_doc: Container Location screen — covers BOTH Assign Container, Change Location and Unassign Container. Component: Frontend/src/components/ContainerLocation/index.tsx. Route: /MobileViewScreen/container-location?mode=assign/change OR ?mode=unassign. Three steps: container → location → confirm.

placeholders.containerHelperText: Scan container QR code or type code manually

errors.noContainerCode: Please scan or enter a container code
errors.noLocationPath: Please scan or enter a location path
errors.multipleLocations: Please scan only one location at a time
errors.damagedContainer: Damaged containers cannot be assigned, moved, or removed.
errors.alreadyAssigned: Container already assigned to this location

alerts.unassignWarning: This will unassign the container from its current location and leave it unassigned.
